caseName: In re Disbarment of Du Bois
caseNameFull: In re Disbarment of Du Bois

opinions.text: Elliott L. Du Bois, of Chicago, Ill., is suspended from the practice of law in this Court, and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
